## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* sectional-analysis (*kē* 科) navigational apparatus to [湛然](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B9%9B%E7%84%B6) Zhànrán's *Zhǐguān yìlì* ([KR6d0132](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0132), T1913) by [從義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%9E%E7%BE%A9) Cóngyì. Companion to Cóngyì's longer *Yìlì zuǎnyào* ([KR6d0139](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0139), X56n0921) main commentary; together the two works constitute Cóngyì's complete two-text apparatus on the *Zhǐguān yìlì*.

**Abstract**

The *Yìlì kē* provides the structural-outline navigational apparatus to Cóngyì's *Yìlì zuǎnyào*, parallel to other Sòng-period *kē* productions on major commentarial works. The dating is bracketed with the main commentary in Cóngyì's productive period c. 1062–1091.
